pipeline.content:
# Generated by GovKit; configure a trusted caller before activation.
name: GovKit change conformance
description: One pinned common-engine invocation over explicit prepared inputs
inputs:
  python:
    description: Absolute path to an isolated Python containing the exact pinned GovKit release
    required: true
  target:
    description: Absolute path to the inspected checkout
    required: true
  policy_target:
    description: Absolute path to a separate caller-trusted policy and pack checkout
    required: true
  request:
    description: Absolute path to caller-accepted request JSON
    required: true
  base:
    description: Full trusted Git base commit SHA
    required: true
  pack_arguments:
    description: Optional absolute path to explicit check argument JSON
    required: false
    default: ''
  observed_at:
    description: Optional explicit observation time for deterministic replay
    required: false
    default: ''
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
  - name: GovKit change conformance
    shell: bash
    run: |
      case "$GOVKIT_PYTHON" in
        /*) ;;
        *) printf '%s\n' 'GOVKIT_PYTHON must be an absolute path' >&2; exit 1 ;;
      esac
      exec -- "$GOVKIT_PYTHON" -I -m cli.pipeline_runtime
    env:
      GOVKIT_BINDING: 
      GOVKIT_PYTHON: ${{ inputs.python }}
      GOVKIT_TARGET: ${{ inputs.target }}
      GOVKIT_POLICY_TARGET: ${{ inputs.policy_target }}
      GOVKIT_REQUEST: ${{ inputs.request }}
      GOVKIT_BASE: ${{ inputs.base }}
      GOVKIT_PACK_ARGUMENTS: ${{ inputs.pack_arguments }}
      GOVKIT_OBSERVED_AT: ${{ inputs.observed_at }}
